ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Write on a piece of paper what you want to be free of and tear it up.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Clear up a misunderstanding with a calm conversation.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Tidy your desk before you start.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Write something lovely about someone you care for.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between the Sun and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.
